title: Projective geometry of the side-tangent construction

blocks.tex:
The companion construction uses the unit circle and its tangent lines. Write
$\langle u,v\rangle=\operatorname{Re}(\overline u v)$ and
$[u,v]=\operatorname{Im}(\overline u v)$, so
$[A,B,C]=[B-A,C-A]$. All indices in a finite fan are cyclic. The projective
map below is a projective automorphism expressed in an affine Klein-model chart; the proof uses preservation of tangent
lines and their half-planes.

blocks.label: st:tangent-intersection
blocks.title: Tangent normals and intersections
blocks.body:
Put $u(\theta)=\cos\theta+i\sin\theta$ and, for unit vectors $u,v$ with
$1+\langle u,v\rangle\ne0$, put
\[
 T(u,v)=\frac{u+v}{1+\langle u,v\rangle}.
\]
Thus $|u(\theta)|=1$, $\langle u(\alpha),u(\beta)\rangle=\cos(\beta-\alpha)$,
and $[u(\alpha),u(\beta)]=\sin(\beta-\alpha)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal
lean.code: noncomputable abbrev normal (θ : ℝ) : ℂ := circlePoint 0 1 θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_normal
lean.code:
lemma cross_normal (α β : ℝ) :
    crossR2 0 (normal α) (normal β) = Real.sin (β - α) := by
  simp [crossR2, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_im
lean.code: @[simp] lemma normal_im (θ : ℝ) : (normal θ).im = Real.sin θ := by simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_re
lean.code: @[simp] lemma normal_re (θ : ℝ) : (normal θ).re = Real.cos θ := by simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.norm_normal
lean.code:
@[simp] lemma norm_normal (θ : ℝ) : ‖normal θ‖ = 1 := by
  simp [normal]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_normal
lean.code:
lemma inner_normal (α β : ℝ) : ⟪normal α, normal β⟫_ℝ = Real.cos (β - α) := by
  simp [Complex.inner, Real.cos_sub]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection
lean.code:
noncomputable def tangentIntersection (u v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)⁻¹ • (u + v)

blocks.label: st:tangent-equations
blocks.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
blocks.body:
The intersection is symmetric and satisfies
$\langle u,T(u,v)\rangle=\langle v,T(u,v)\rangle=1$.
For $0\le\beta-\alpha<\pi$ its denominator is positive.
The normal map is continuous, and $T$ is jointly continuous wherever its
denominator is nonzero, including $T(u,u)=u$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_tangentIntersection_right
lean.code:
lemma inner_tangentIntersection_right {u v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) : ⟪v, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [tangentIntersection_comm]
  exact inner_tangentIntersection_left hv (by rwa [real_inner_comm])

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.inner_tangentIntersection_left
lean.code:
lemma inner_tangentIntersection_left {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) : ⟪u, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, one_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma normal_denominator_pos {α β : ℝ} (h₀ : α ≤ β) (hπ : β - α < Real.pi) :
    0 < 1 + ⟪normal α, normal β⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [inner_normal]
  have h := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (sub_nonneg.mpr h₀) le_rfl hπ
  rw [Real.cos_pi] at h
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuousAt_tangentIntersection
lean.code:
lemma continuousAt_tangentIntersection {u v : ℂ} (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ tangentIntersection p.1 p.2) (u, v) := by
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ 1 + ⟪p.1, p.2⟫_ℝ) (u, v) :=
    continuousAt_const.add (continuous_fst.inner continuous_snd).continuousAt
  exact (hc.inv₀ hd).smul (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd).continuousAt

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.continuous_normal
lean.code:
lemma continuous_normal : Continuous normal := by
  change Continuous (circleMap 0 1)
  fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_comm
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_comm (u v : ℂ) :
    tangentIntersection u v = tangentIntersection v u := by
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_comm u v, add_comm u v]

deps.title: Tangent normals and intersections
deps.label: st:tangent-intersection

blocks.tex:
Take the scalar product of the displayed formula with either unit normal.
The denominator is $1+\cos(\beta-\alpha)>0$ on the stated angular range.
The formulas are sums, scalar products and division by a nonzero continuous
function, which also proves continuity at coincident normals.

blocks.label: st:fan-support
blocks.title: Ordered circle points and strict tangent support
blocks.body:
For unit $u,v$ and nonzero tangent denominator,
\[
 [u,v,w]=[u,v]\bigl(1-\langle w,T(u,v)\rangle\bigr).
\]
For $\alpha<\beta<\gamma<\alpha+2\pi$ and $\beta-\alpha<\pi$,
$\langle u(\gamma),T(u(\alpha),u(\beta))\rangle<1$.
The same holds when $\gamma<\alpha<\beta<\gamma+2\pi$.
More generally, for $z(\theta)=c+Re^{i\theta}$,
\[
 [z(\alpha),z(\beta),z(\gamma)]
 =4R^2\sin\frac{\beta-\alpha}{2}\sin\frac{\gamma-\beta}{2}
       \sin\frac{\gamma-\alpha}{2}>0
\]
when $R\ne0$ and the three angles have the first cyclic ordering.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint
lean.code: noncomputable abbrev circlePoint (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) : ℂ := circleMap O R θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered
    (O : ℂ) {R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (h₀₁ : θ₀ < θ₁) (h₁₂ : θ₁ < θ₂) (hspan : θ₂ < θ₀ + 2 * Real.pi) :
    0 < crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁)
      (circlePoint O R θ₂) := by
  have hsin₀₁ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin₁₂ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hsin₀₂ : 0 < Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half]
  positivity

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) (circlePoint O R θ₂) =
      R ^ 2 * (Real.sin (θ₁ - θ₀) + Real.sin (θ₂ - θ₁) -
        Real.sin (θ₂ - θ₀)) := by
  change crossR2 (circleMap O R θ₀) (circleMap O R θ₁) (circleMap O R θ₂) = _
  unfold crossR2
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, circlePoint_re, circlePoint_im]
  rw [Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_eq_tangent_support
lean.code:
lemma cross_eq_tangent_support {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) :
    crossR2 u v w = crossR2 0 u v * (1 - ⟪w, tangentIntersection u v⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hu' : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm u
    rw [hu, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hv' : v.re ^ 2 + v.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm v
    rw [hv, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  simp only [tangentIntersection, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right]
  field_simp
  simp [crossR2, Complex.inner]
  linear_combination (u.re * w.im - u.im * w.re) * hv' -
    (v.re * w.im - v.im * w.re) * hu'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_im
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_im (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    (circlePoint O R θ).im = O.im + R * Real.sin θ := by
  change (circleMap O R θ).im = _
  simp [circleMap]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_half
    (O : ℂ) (R θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) :
    crossR2 (circlePoint O R θ₀) (circlePoint O R θ₁) (circlePoint O R θ₂) =
      4 * R ^ 2 * Real.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) *
        Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) * Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₀) / 2) := by
  rw [crossR2_circlePoint_eq_sin_sub]
  have hsum : θ₂ - θ₀ = (θ₁ - θ₀) + (θ₂ - θ₁) := by ring
  rw [hsum, sin_add_sin_sub_sin_add]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_add_two_pi
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_add_two_pi (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    circlePoint O R (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = circlePoint O R θ := by
  change circleMap O R (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = circleMap O R θ
  exact periodic_circleMap O R θ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.circlePoint_re
lean.code:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_re (O : ℂ) (R θ : ℝ) :
    (circlePoint O R θ).re = O.re + R * Real.cos θ := by
  change (circleMap O R θ).re = _
  simp [circleMap]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_lt_of_wrapped
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_lt_of_wrapped {α β γ : ℝ} (hγα : γ < α)
    (hαβ : α < β) (hgap : β - α < Real.pi) (hspan : β < γ + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ⟪normal γ, tangentIntersection (normal α) (normal β)⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have h := normal_support_lt_of_ordered hαβ hgap hspan
    (by linarith : γ + 2 * Real.pi < α + 2 * Real.pi)
  simpa only [normal, circlePoint_add_two_pi] using h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_support_lt_of_ordered
lean.code:
lemma normal_support_lt_of_ordered {α β γ : ℝ} (hαβ : α < β)
    (hgap : β - α < Real.pi) (hβγ : β < γ) (hspan : γ < α + 2 * Real.pi) :
    ⟪normal γ, tangentIntersection (normal α) (normal β)⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  have h := crossR2_circlePoint_pos_of_ordered 0 (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
    hαβ hβγ hspan
  rw [cross_eq_tangent_support (norm_normal α) (norm_normal β)
    (normal_denominator_pos hαβ.le hgap).ne', cross_normal] at h
  have hs := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (sub_pos.mpr hαβ) hgap
  nlinarith

deps.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
deps.label: st:tangent-equations

blocks.tex:
Expand the determinant and use $|u|=|v|=1$ for the duality identity.
For three circle points the expansion first gives
$R^2(\sin(\gamma-\beta)+\sin(\beta-\alpha)-\sin(\gamma-\alpha))$;
half-angle identities give the product. Its three factors are positive in
one cyclic turn. Divide the duality identity by
$[u(\alpha),u(\beta)]=\sin(\beta-\alpha)>0$.
For the wrapped case replace $\gamma$ by $\gamma+2\pi$.

blocks.label: st:interior-contact
blocks.title: Interior contacts and positive tangent edges
blocks.body:
For unit $u,v,w$ with $[u,v]>0$ and $[v,w]>0$, define
$\alpha=[u,v]/(1+\langle u,v\rangle)>0$ and
$\beta=[v,w]/(1+\langle v,w\rangle)>0$. Then
\[
 T(u,v)=v-\alpha iv,\qquad T(v,w)=v+\beta iv,
 \qquad T(v,w)-T(u,v)=(\alpha+\beta)iv.
\]
In particular $v$ lies in the open segment joining the two tangent vertices,
and that segment is nonzero and positively directed along $iv$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_eq_add
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_eq_add {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    tangentIntersection u v = u + (crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)) • (Complex.I * u) := by
  have hu' : u.re ^ 2 + u.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h := Complex.sq_norm u
    rw [hu, Complex.normSq_apply] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [tangentIntersection, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, zero_add,
      smul_eq_mul]
  all_goals field_simp
  all_goals simp [crossR2, Complex.inner]
  · linear_combination -v.re * hu'
  · linear_combination -v.im * hu'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangentIntersection_eq_sub
lean.code:
lemma tangentIntersection_eq_sub {u v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    tangentIntersection u v = v - (crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)) • (Complex.I * v) := by
  rw [tangentIntersection_comm, tangentIntersection_eq_add hv (by rwa [real_inner_comm])]
  simp only [crossR2_swap 0 u v, real_inner_comm v u, neg_div, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul
lean.code:
lemma tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul {u v w : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (h₁ : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) (h₂ : 0 < crossR2 0 v w) :
    ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ tangentIntersection v w - tangentIntersection u v =
      ℓ • (Complex.I * v) := by
  have hd₁ := normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv h₁
  have hd₂ := normal_pair_denominator_pos hv hw h₂
  refine ⟨crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ) +
    crossR2 0 v w / (1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ), add_pos (div_pos h₁ hd₁) (div_pos h₂ hd₂), ?_⟩
  rw [tangentIntersection_eq_sub hv hd₁.ne', tangentIntersection_eq_add hv hd₂.ne', add_smul]
  abel

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_pair_denominator_pos
lean.code:
lemma normal_pair_denominator_pos {u v : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) : 0 < 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ := by
  have huv : u + v ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hvu : v = -u := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right he
    rw [hvu] at hc
    simp [crossR2, mul_comm] at hc
  have h := norm_add_sq_real u v
  rw [hu, hv] at h
  have hp := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr huv)
  nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.contact_mem_openSegment
lean.code:
theorem contact_mem_openSegment {u v w : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd₁ : 0 < 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ) (hd₂ : 0 < 1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ)
    (h₁ : 0 < crossR2 0 u v) (h₂ : 0 < crossR2 0 v w) :
    v ∈ openSegment ℝ (tangentIntersection u v) (tangentIntersection v w) := by
  let α := crossR2 0 u v / (1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ)
  let β := crossR2 0 v w / (1 + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ)
  have hα : 0 < α := div_pos h₁ hd₁
  have hβ : 0 < β := div_pos h₂ hd₂
  have hab : 0 < α + β := add_pos hα hβ
  refine ⟨β / (α + β), α / (α + β), div_pos hβ hab, div_pos hα hab, ?_, ?_⟩
  · field_simp
    ring
  · rw [tangentIntersection_eq_sub hv hd₁.ne', tangentIntersection_eq_add hv hd₂.ne']
    change (β / (α + β)) • (v - α • (Complex.I * v)) +
      (α / (α + β)) • (v + β • (Complex.I * v)) = v
    match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring

deps.title: The two tangent equations and their continuous extension
deps.label: st:tangent-equations

blocks.tex:
Positive determinant excludes antipodal unit vectors; the squared norm of
$u+v$ gives $1+\langle u,v\rangle>0$. Expand the two tangent-frame identities.
The coefficients $\beta/(\alpha+\beta)$ and $\alpha/(\alpha+\beta)$ express
$v$ as a strictly interior convex combination. Subtraction gives the edge formula.

blocks.label: st:projective-map
blocks.title: Projective ball normalization
blocks.body:
For $a\in\mathbb C$ and $\sigma>0$ with $\sigma^2+|a|^2=1$, set
\[
 D_a(x)=1-\langle a,x\rangle,\quad
 A_a(x)=\sigma x+\left(\frac{\langle a,x\rangle}{1+\sigma}-1\right)a,
 \qquad B_a(x)=\frac{A_a(x)}{D_a(x)}.
\]
All geometric applications use the positive chart $D_a(x)>0$.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.denominator
lean.code: def denominator (a x : E) : ℝ := 1 - ⟪a, x⟫_ℝ

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.transform
lean.code:
noncomputable def transform (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (x : E) : E :=
  (denominator a x)⁻¹ • numerator a σ x

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.numerator
lean.code:
noncomputable def numerator (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (x : E) : E :=
  σ • x + (⟪a, x⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - 1) • a

blocks.label: st:projective-support
blocks.title: The bilinear identity and tangent half-planes
blocks.body:
The numerator satisfies
$\langle A_a(x),A_a(y)\rangle-D_a(x)D_a(y)
=\sigma^2(\langle x,y\rangle-1)$. Hence, wherever both denominators are nonzero,
\[
 1-\langle B_a(x),B_a(y)\rangle
 =\frac{\sigma^2(1-\langle x,y\rangle)}{D_a(x)D_a(y)}.
\]
Unit normals remain unit, and tangent equations remain tangent equations.
With positive denominators, a strict inequality $\langle x,y\rangle<1$
is equivalent to the same inequality for their images.
If $|a|<1$ and $|x|\le1$, then $D_a(x)>0$.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one
lean.code:
theorem denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one {a x : E} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    0 < denominator a x := by
  have h := real_inner_le_norm a x
  dsimp [denominator]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg x]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.one_sub_inner_transform
lean.code:
theorem one_sub_inner_transform (a x y : E) {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hx : denominator a x ≠ 0) (hy : denominator a y ≠ 0) :
    1 - ⟪transform a σ x, transform a σ y⟫_ℝ =
      σ ^ 2 * (1 - ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ) / (denominator a x * denominator a y) := by
  have h := numerator_inner_sub a x y hσ hsq
  simp only [transform, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  field_simp
  nlinarith only [h]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one
lean.code:
theorem inner_transform_eq_one {a u x : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : denominator a u ≠ 0) (hx : denominator a x ≠ 0)
    (htangent : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) :
    ⟪transform a σ u, transform a σ x⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  have h := one_sub_inner_transform a u x hσ hsq hu hx
  rw [htangent, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_div] at h
  linarith

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.numerator_inner_sub
lean.code:
theorem numerator_inner_sub (a x y : E) {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    ⟪numerator a σ x, numerator a σ y⟫_ℝ - denominator a x * denominator a y =
      σ ^ 2 * (⟪x, y⟫_ℝ - 1) := by
  have ha : ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ = 1 - σ ^ 2 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    linarith
  simp only [numerator, denominator, inner_add_left, inner_add_right,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm a x, ha]
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one
lean.code:
theorem norm_transform_eq_one {a u : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hden : denominator a u ≠ 0) :
    ‖transform a σ u‖ = 1 := by
  have h := one_sub_inner_transform a u u hσ hsq hden hden
  simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, one_pow, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_div] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (transform a σ u)]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_lt_one_iff
lean.code:
theorem inner_transform_lt_one_iff {a u x : E} {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hu : 0 < denominator a u) (hx : 0 < denominator a x) :
    ⟪transform a σ u, transform a σ x⟫_ℝ < 1 ↔ ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ < 1 := by
  rw [← sub_pos, one_sub_inner_transform a u x hσ hsq hu.ne' hx.ne',
    div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (mul_pos hu hx),
    mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (sq_pos_of_pos hσ), sub_pos]

deps.title: Projective ball normalization
deps.label: st:projective-map

blocks.tex:
Expand the numerator and substitute $|a|^2=1-\sigma^2$. Division gives the
normalized identity. Set $x=y$ for preservation of the unit circle; set the
inner product to one for tangent incidence; take signs for strict support.
Finally $\langle a,x\rangle\le|a|\,|x|<1$ on the closed unit ball.

blocks.label: st:projective-orientation
blocks.title: Orientation in the positive chart
blocks.body:
For any $x,y$,
\[
 [B_a(x),B_a(y)]
 =\frac{\sigma\bigl([x,y]+[a,x-y]\bigr)}{D_a(x)D_a(y)}.
\]
In particular, for adjacent unit normals with $[u,v]>0$,
\[
 [B_a(u),B_a(v)]
 =\frac{\sigma[u,v]D_a(T(u,v))}{D_a(u)D_a(v)}>0
\]
provided $|a|<1$ and $D_a(T(u,v))>0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_transform_normals
lean.code:
lemma cross_transform_normals {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hd : 1 + ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    crossR2 0 (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) =
      σ * crossR2 0 u v * ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v) /
        (ProjectiveBall.denominator a u * ProjectiveBall.denominator a v) := by
  have he : ProjectiveBall.area u v + ProjectiveBall.area a (u - v) =
      crossR2 u v a := by
    simp only [ProjectiveBall.area, crossR2, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
    ring
  have h := ProjectiveBall.area_transform a u v hσ hsq
  rw [he, cross_eq_tangent_support hu hv hd a] at h
  simpa only [crossR2, Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, sub_zero,
    ProjectiveBall.area, ProjectiveBall.denominator, mul_assoc] using h

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area_numerator
lean.code:
lemma area_numerator (a u v : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    area (numerator a σ u) (numerator a σ v) =
      σ * (area u v + area a (u - v)) := by
  have ha : σ ^ 2 + (a.re ^ 2 + a.im ^ 2) = 1 := by
    simpa only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, ← pow_two] using hsq
  simp only [area, numerator, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re,
    Complex.smul_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  linear_combination σ * (1 + σ) * (u.re * v.im - u.im * v.re) * ha

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area_transform
lean.code:
theorem area_transform (a u v : ℂ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) :
    area (transform a σ u) (transform a σ v) =
      σ * (area u v + area a (u - v)) / (denominator a u * denominator a v) := by
  have h := area_numerator a u v hσ hsq
  simp only [transform, area, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  simp only [area, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at h
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  linear_combination (denominator a u)⁻¹ * (denominator a v)⁻¹ * h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_transform_normals_pos
lean.code:
lemma cross_transform_normals_pos {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v)
    (hx : 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v)) :
    0 < crossR2 0 (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) := by
  rw [cross_transform_normals hσ hsq hu hv (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv hc).ne']
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hσ hc) hx)
    (mul_pos (ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hu.le)
      (ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hv.le))

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.area
lean.code: def area (u v : ℂ) : ℝ := u.re * v.im - u.im * v.re

blocks.tex:
The determinant of the two numerators is
$\sigma([x,y]+[a,x-y])$, by direct expansion and the relation between
$\sigma$ and $a$. For unit $u,v$, the numerator in parentheses equals
$[u,v,a]$. Apply the tangent-support identity and use positivity of all factors.
This is why positive denominators are checked at the tangent vertices as well
as at the unit normals.

blocks.body:
Under the hypotheses of the preceding orientation lemma,
\[
 B_a(T(u,v))=T(B_a(u),B_a(v)).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.transform_tangentIntersection
lean.code:
lemma transform_tangentIntersection {a u v : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hc : 0 < crossR2 0 u v)
    (hx : 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (tangentIntersection u v)) :
    ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (tangentIntersection u v) =
      tangentIntersection (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ u) (ProjectiveBall.transform a σ v) := by
  have hdu := ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hu.le
  have hdv := ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha hv.le
  have hu' := ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hu hdu.ne'
  have hv' := ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hv hdv.ne'
  have hc' := cross_transform_normals_pos ha hσ hsq hu hv hc hx
  have hd := (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu hv hc).ne'
  have hd' := (normal_pair_denominator_pos hu' hv' hc').ne'
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero hc'.ne'
  · rw [inner_sub_right, ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hdu.ne' hx.ne'
      (inner_tangentIntersection_left hu hd), inner_tangentIntersection_left hu' hd']
    exact sub_self 1
  · rw [inner_sub_right, ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_eq_one hσ hsq hdv.ne' hx.ne'
      (inner_tangentIntersection_right hv hd), inner_tangentIntersection_right hv' hd']
    exact sub_self 1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero
lean.code:
lemma eq_zero_of_two_inner_eq_zero {u v z : ℂ} (hcross : crossR2 0 u v ≠ 0)
    (hu : ⟪u, z⟫_ℝ = 0) (hv : ⟪v, z⟫_ℝ = 0) : z = 0 := by
  have hre : crossR2 0 u v * z.re = 0 := by
    simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hu hv
    simp only [crossR2, sub_zero]
    linear_combination v.im * hu - u.im * hv
  have him : crossR2 0 u v * z.im = 0 := by
    simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hu hv
    simp only [crossR2, sub_zero]
    linear_combination u.re * hv - v.re * hu
  exact Complex.ext ((mul_eq_zero.mp hre).resolve_left hcross)
    ((mul_eq_zero.mp him).resolve_left hcross)

blocks.tex:
Both sides have inner product one with the two transformed unit normals.
Their determinant is positive, so these two linear equations have a unique
solution: subtract them and invert the nonsingular two-by-two coefficient
matrix. This proves equality of the actual vertices.

blocks.label: st:projective-field
blocks.title: The labelled balancing field
blocks.body:
For a finite labelled configuration $x_i$ and fixed real coefficients $c_i$, set
\[
 F_x(a)=\sum_i\frac{c_i x_i}{D_a(x_i)}.
\]
The coefficients, including zero coefficients, remain attached to their original labels.

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.field
lean.code:
noncomputable def field (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E) : E :=
  ∑ i, (c i / denominator a (x i)) • x i

blocks.label: st:projective-balance
blocks.title: A field zero gives exact projective balance
blocks.body:
If all denominators are nonzero, $\sum_i c_i=0$ and $F_x(a)=0$, then
$\sum_i c_i B_a(x_i)=0$. More explicitly,
\[
 \sum_i\frac{c_i}{D_a(x_i)}=\sum_i c_i+\langle a,F_x(a)\rangle.
\]
For arbitrary weights $w_i$ the numerator sum is
\[
 \sum_iw_iA_a(x_i)=\sigma\sum_iw_ix_i+
 \left(\frac{\langle a,\sum_iw_ix_i\rangle}{1+\sigma}-\sum_iw_i\right)a.
\]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_smul_transform_eq_zero_of_field_eq_zero
lean.code:
theorem sum_smul_transform_eq_zero_of_field_eq_zero (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E)
    (a : E) (σ : ℝ) (hden : ∀ i, denominator a (x i) ≠ 0)
    (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0) (hfield : field c x a = 0) :
    ∑ i, c i • transform a σ (x i) = 0 := by
  have hw : ∑ i, c i / denominator a (x i) = 0 := by
    rw [sum_div_denominator c x a hden, hsum, hfield, inner_zero_right, add_zero]
  have he : ∑ i, c i • transform a σ (x i) =
      ∑ i, (c i / denominator a (x i)) • numerator a σ (x i) := by
    simp only [transform, smul_smul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [he, sum_smul_numerator]
  change σ • field c x a + (⟪a, field c x a⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - _) • a = 0
  simp only [hfield, inner_zero_right, zero_div, hw, sub_self, smul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_div_denominator
lean.code:
lemma sum_div_denominator (c : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E)
    (hden : ∀ i, denominator a (x i) ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i, c i / denominator a (x i) = (∑ i, c i) + ⟪a, field c x a⟫_ℝ := by
  have hi : ∀ i, c i / denominator a (x i) =
      c i + (c i / denominator a (x i)) * ⟪a, x i⟫_ℝ := by
    intro i
    have hn := hden i
    unfold denominator at hn ⊢
    field_simp
    ring
  simpa only [field, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_right, Finset.sum_add_distrib] using
    Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun i _ ↦ hi i)

lean.name: ProjectiveBall.sum_smul_numerator
lean.code:
lemma sum_smul_numerator (w : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → E) (a : E) (σ : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, w i • numerator a σ (x i) =
      σ • (∑ i, w i • x i) +
        (⟪a, ∑ i, w i • x i⟫_ℝ / (1 + σ) - ∑ i, w i) • a := by
  simp only [numerator, smul_add, smul_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    inner_sum, real_inner_smul_right]
  simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, mul_sub, mul_one, sub_smul, ← mul_div_assoc,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.sum_div, mul_comm]

blocks.tex:
Use $D_a(x_i)+\langle a,x_i\rangle=1$ for the first identity and linearity
for the second. Substitute $w_i=c_i/D_a(x_i)$; both the weighted vector sum
and the weight sum vanish, giving the asserted balance without changing any coefficient.

blocks.label: st:strict-fan
blocks.title: Strict tangential fan
blocks.body:
A strict tangential fan is a cyclic family of unit normals $U_i$ and vertices
$Y_i=T(U_i,U_{i+1})$ with $[U_i,U_{i+1}]>0$ and
$\langle U_j,Y_i\rangle<1$ for $j\ne i,i+1$.
The geometric record also includes $U_{i+1}\in(Y_i,Y_{i+1})$,
$Y_{i+1}-Y_i=\ell_i iU_{i+1}$ with $\ell_i>0$, nonzero edges, and
$[Y_i,Y_{i+1},Y_j]>0$ for every nonincident vertex $j$.
Either finite representatives or $\mathbb Z/n$ may index the same cyclic data.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
structure IsCyclicStrictTangentialFan [NeZero n] (U Y : ZMod n → ℂ) : Prop where
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1
  normal_cross_pos : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1))
  vertex_eq : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1))
  strict_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1
  contact_interior : ∀ i, U (i + 1) ∈ openSegment ℝ (Y i) (Y (i + 1))
  edge_pos : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1))
  edge_ne : ∀ i, Y (i + 1) ≠ Y i
  cross_support : StrictConvexEdgeSupport Y

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.IsStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
structure IsStrictTangentialFan {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (U Y : Fin n → ℂ) : Prop where
  unit_normal : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1
  normal_cross_pos : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1))
  vertex_eq : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1))
  strict_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1
  contact_interior : ∀ i, U (i + 1) ∈ openSegment ℝ (Y i) (Y (i + 1))
  edge_pos : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1))
  edge_ne : ∀ i, Y (i + 1) ≠ Y i
  cross_support : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → 0 < crossR2 (Y i) (Y (i + 1)) (Y j)

blocks.label: st:strict-fan-geometry
blocks.title: The elementary data imply all strict-fan properties
blocks.body:
Unit normals, positive successive determinants, tangent intersection identities
and strict nonincident support imply the full strict-fan record.
For an edge $y-x=\ell iu$ with $\langle u,x\rangle=1$,
\[
 [x,y,z]=\ell(1-\langle u,z\rangle).
\]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry
lean.code:
theorem isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {U Y : Fin n → ℂ}
    (hu : ∀ i, ‖U i‖ = 1) (hc : ∀ i, 0 < crossR2 0 (U i) (U (i + 1)))
    (hy : ∀ i, Y i = tangentIntersection (U i) (U (i + 1)))
    (hs : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → ⟪U j, Y i⟫_ℝ < 1) :
    IsStrictTangentialFan U Y := by
  have he : ∀ i, ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ ∧ Y (i + 1) - Y i = ℓ • (Complex.I * U (i + 1)) := by
    intro i
    rw [hy i, hy (i + 1)]
    exact tangent_edge_eq_pos_smul (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hu (i + 1 + 1)) (hc i) (hc (i + 1))
  refine ⟨hu, hc, hy, hs, ?_, he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hy i, hy (i + 1)]
    exact contact_mem_openSegment (hu (i + 1))
      (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hc i))
      (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu (i + 1)) (hu (i + 1 + 1)) (hc (i + 1)))
      (hc i) (hc (i + 1))
  · intro i hzero
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := he i
    have hu₀ : U (i + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      simpa [h] using hu (i + 1)
    have hn := smul_ne_zero hℓ.ne' (mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero hu₀)
    apply hn
    rw [← heq, hzero, sub_self]
  · intro i j hji hjnext
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := he i
    have hi : ⟪U (i + 1), Y i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
      rw [hy i]
      exact inner_tangentIntersection_right (hu (i + 1))
        (normal_pair_denominator_pos (hu i) (hu (i + 1)) (hc i)).ne'
    rw [cross_of_tangent_edge heq hi]
    exact mul_pos hℓ (sub_pos.mpr (hs j (i + 1) hjnext.symm
      (fun h ↦ hji (add_right_cancel h).symm)))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.cross_of_tangent_edge
lean.code:
lemma cross_of_tangent_edge {u x y z : ℂ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hedge : y - x = ℓ • (Complex.I * u)) (hux : ⟪u, x⟫_ℝ = 1) :
    crossR2 x y z = ℓ * (1 - ⟪u, z⟫_ℝ) := by
  change (y - x).re * (z - x).im - (y - x).im * (z - x).re = _
  rw [hedge]
  simp only [Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, zero_add,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, smul_eq_mul, Complex.inner,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im] at hux
  linear_combination ℓ * hux

blocks.tex:
The contact lemma supplies positive tangent lengths and interior contacts.
A positive multiple of a rotated unit vector is nonzero. The determinant
identity follows by expanding the inner product; strict support then makes
every nonincident vertex lie strictly to the left of the edge.

blocks.label: st:projective-fan
blocks.title: The finite square perturbation has strict geometry
blocks.body:
Take the square-perturbation angles with $0<\eta\le1$ from the balancing
construction. Apply $B_a$ to their normals and tangent vertices, with
$|a|<1$, $\sigma>0$, $\sigma^2+|a|^2=1$, and positive vertex denominators.
The result is a strict tangential fan. The last angular successor $2\pi$
represents the first normal, so this assertion includes the cyclic seam.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan
lean.code:
theorem projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) {a : ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ < 1)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsq : σ ^ 2 + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 1)
    (hd : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (fanVertex n p q r η i)) :
    IsStrictTangentialFan
      (fun i : Fin n ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)))
      (fun i : Fin n ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i)) := by
  have hnorm : ∀ i : Fin n, ‖normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)‖ = 1 := fun i ↦ norm_normal _
  have hdn : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 < ProjectiveBall.denominator a (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)) :=
    fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.denominator_pos_of_norm_le_one ha (hnorm i).le
  have hc := fan_normal_cross_pos hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁
  have hy := fanVertex_eq_cyclic hn hpq hqr hr η
  apply isStrictTangentialFan_of_geometry
  · intro i
    exact ProjectiveBall.norm_transform_eq_one hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hdn i).ne'
  · intro i
    exact cross_transform_normals_pos ha hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hnorm (i + 1)) (hc i)
      (by rw [← hy i]; exact hd i)
  · intro i
    rw [hy i]
    exact transform_tangentIntersection ha hσ hsq (hnorm i) (hnorm (i + 1)) (hc i)
      (by rw [← hy i]; exact hd i)
  · intro i j hji hjnext
    exact (ProjectiveBall.inner_transform_lt_one_iff hσ hsq (hdn j) (hd i)).mpr
      (fanVertex_strict_support hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁ i j hji hjnext)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fanVertex_eq_cyclic
lean.code:
lemma fanVertex_eq_cyclic {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    fanVertex n p q r η i = tangentIntersection (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i))
      (normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n))) := by
  rw [normal_fanAngle_succ hn hpq hqr hr]
  rfl

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.fan_normal_cross_pos
lean.code:
lemma fan_normal_cross_pos {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη₁ : η ≤ 1) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < crossR2 0 (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i))
      (normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n))) := by
  rw [normal_fanAngle_succ hn hpq hqr hr, cross_normal]
  exact Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
    (sub_pos.mpr (fanAngle_strictMono (by omega) hη hη₁ (Nat.lt_succ_self _)))
    (fanAngle_step_lt_pi hn hp hpq hqr hη.le hη₁ i)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.normal_fanAngle_succ
lean.code:
lemma normal_fanAngle_succ {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    normal (fanAngle n p q r η (i + 1 : Fin n)) =
      normal (fanAngle n p q r η ((i : ℕ) + 1)) := by
  have h_one : (1 : Fin n).val = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < n)]
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n
  · rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi]
  · have he : (i : ℕ) + 1 = n := by omega
    rw [Fin.val_add, h_one, he, Nat.mod_self, fanAngle_zero,
      fanAngle_end (by omega) hr hpq hqr]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp

blocks.tex:
Successive lifted angle gaps lie in $(0,\pi)$, so their sine determinants
are positive. The end angle is $2\pi$ and the starting angle is zero.
The projective support and orientation identities preserve the unit normals,
positive adjacent determinants, all tangent incidences and all nonincident
strict inequalities. Apply the full-geometry lemma.

blocks.label: st:balanced-fan
blocks.title: A balanced strict tangential fan
blocks.body:
Let $n\ge4$, $0<p<q<r<n$, and $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}c_i=0$, with
$c_0>0$, $c_p<0$, $c_q>0$, $c_r<0$.
There is a strict tangential fan $(U,Y)$ with
$\sum_i c_iY_i=0$, preserving all $n$ original labels and coefficients.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.SideTangent.exists_balanced_strictTangentialFan
lean.code:
theorem exists_balanced_strictTangentialFan {n p q r : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) (hqr : q < r) (hr : r < n)
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ i, c i = 0)
    (h₀ : 0 < c ⟨0, by omega⟩) (h₁ : c ⟨p, by omega⟩ < 0)
    (h₂ : 0 < c ⟨q, by omega⟩) (h₃ : c ⟨r, hr⟩ < 0) :
    ∃ U Y : Fin n → ℂ, IsStrictTangentialFan U Y ∧ ∑ i, c i • Y i = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hη₁, a, σ, ha, hσ, hsq, hd, hb⟩ :=
    exists_balanced_squareFan hn hp hpq hqr hr c hsum h₀ h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact ⟨fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (normal (fanAngle n p q r η i)),
    fun i ↦ ProjectiveBall.transform a σ (fanVertex n p q r η i),
    projective_squareFan_isStrictTangentialFan hn hp hpq hqr hr hη hη₁.le ha hσ hsq hd, hb⟩

blocks.tex:
The square-field perturbation theorem supplies $0<\eta<1$ and projective
parameters with positive denominators and exact weighted balance. The preceding
lemma proves that these same transformed normals and vertices satisfy the full
strict tangential geometry; no limiting or collapsed polygon is used as the witness.
